title: androsace elongata subsp. acuta
intro: Androsace elongata subsp. acuta, commonly known as Himalayan Rock Jasmine, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, characterized by its small, white, star-shaped flowers and narrow leaves. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, gastrointestinal problems, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Rock Jasmine include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
